episodes.synopsis: Kurumi enters the world of forex to prove she can succeed where her mother once failed.
episodes.title: What's Forex?

episodes.synopsis: After some advice from her friend Mochiko, Kurumi takes a risky position trading the Australian dollar.
episodes.title: It's Okay, I've Got Leverage

episodes.synopsis: AUD/JPY takes Kurumi on a wild ride, and she finds herself at risk of losing all the money she "borrowed."
episodes.title: Do I Have to Cut My Losses…?

episodes.synopsis: Kurumi has an awkward confrontation with her dad, and then gets roped into teaching forex to a new investor.
episodes.title: Having No Unrealized Losses Is the Best

episodes.synopsis: Kurumi quits forex and tries hard to find a new hobby, but the temptation to start trading again is strong.
episodes.title: Long? Short? Which Do I Choose?

episodes.synopsis: Mebuki attempts to trade forex without Kurumi's help, but does she know enough about how the markets work?
episodes.title: Pay Attention to Economic Indicators!

episodes.synopsis: The girls begin an investment competition, all while Mebuki clings tenaciously to her risky short position.
episodes.title: I Don't Wanna Have a Forced Liquidation...

episodes.synopsis: After losing all her initial funds, Mebuki resorts to borrowing money to maintain a short position on USD/JPY.
episodes.title: Monetary Easing Is a Wild Party
